description: The line plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the accuracy of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations," ranges from 0 to 1500 with major tick marks at intervals of 250, representing the number of examples provided to the model. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 50 to 55 with major tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating the model's performance. The plot displays four models: "Squared Exponential" (solid black line), "Tanh" (solid dark blue line), "ELU" (solid purple line), and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" (dashed magenta line). The "Squared Exponential" model starts at an accuracy of approximately 52.5 and remains relatively stable, ending at about 55.2. The "Tanh" model begins at around 50.5 and increases slightly to approximately 51.2. The "ELU" model starts at about 46.5 and stays relatively flat, ending at 46.8. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model starts at approximately 47.5 and shows a slight decline, ending at around 47.0.
